text_block_list.text:
One morning. Narita Taishin was talking to 
someone in front of the dorm.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Taishin-chan. Well then, take care. Have a 
nice time♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"And also... you said you twisted your leg 
a bit, are you okay?"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
She mentioned running out of her favorite 
medical tape, though...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...I'm fine. It's no big deal.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...See ya.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? Oh, it's you.
choice_data_list:
Good morning. What you were talking about 
just now was...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Super Creek-san, your roommate... Did she 
know about this?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"Does it look like that to you? Well, 
maybe more so than before."

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Because there was quite a lot of conflict 
at first.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Good girl, Taishin-chan, there, there♪

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh? Are you mocking me?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
That's not it at all~. Come now, don't be 
shy...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
――!? Stay away from me! Just leave me 
alone!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Huh...? U-Um...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
And after that, she barely spoke for a 
while, but then gradually started to open 
up a bit...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
And that brings us to now. Something like 
that.
choice_data_list: Have you opened up a bit?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Nothing. I'm just putting up with it. She 
does whatever she wants in our room, but 
well, it's not really causing any trouble.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
It's not like I want to pick a fight with 
you. Come on, aren't you going to 
training?
—That night.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you... Got a second? Creek-san hasn't 
come back yet.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if something happened. They're a 
stranger, so I could just leave them 
alone, but still...
choice_data_list: We should go look for it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. It'd be a pain if they got caught 
up in something, so just in case...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hm? Someone's walking this way. That's...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... Creek, I know I'm the one who 
offered to go shopping with ya, but I'm at 
my limit here.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Why do you gotta be so picky just buying 
daily goods? Anything'll do fine, won't 
it?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"I can't let that happen. My girl is quite 
delicate, you see."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Sneaking in the best match. While 
occasionally mixing in ones that make them 
think, 'I'm just picking at random~.'

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
What a pain. Dealing with someone like 
that just sounds exhausting.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Wouldn't it be better to just lay it all 
out honestly and break the ice already?"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
No, I understand that it's better not to 
rush.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It might take some time, but this pace is 
the best. Which means—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"I just thought that someday, maybe you'd 
show me a natural smile."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
*sigh* Creek sure has a lot of patience. 
Is this that "a mother's strength" thing?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Trainer... Let's go...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
The things I thought were normal... they 
weren't normal at all...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hey, I...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...It's nothing. I just felt like... 'I've 
still got a long way to go.' That's all.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Then I will wait. Right here.
choice_data_list: Why don't you wait in the room?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
It's fine. I'll wait here. Why don't you 
go back to your room?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...I see. Then keep an eye on the side 
opposite mine.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Phew, I'm so sorry I'm late~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Taishin-chan. Don't tell me you were 
waiting for me to get back...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
It's not really like that. Just, 
somehow...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry. I was looking for medical tape, 
and I had trouble finding it.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
But I found something Taishin-chan really 
liked, so it's all good♪

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Medical... tape... Mine...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I don't need it! ...You idiot.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Huh, Taishin-chan?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"If something like that slows me down, 
there's no point. I don't need it."

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Why don't you just give it to that Trainer 
over there?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: —Later.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Taishin-chan...
—The next day.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Trainer. Mmh!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Hand over the tape. It's not like you're 
gonna use it anyway.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I'll take what I can get. To make up for 
holding back and waiting last night.
